draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the frustration around this charge.

I want to clarify our refund policy, since it works a bit differently than described: full refunds are available for requests made within 14 calendar days of the charge date. Requests made after that 14-day window aren't eligible for a standard refund — those can only be approved as a goodwill exception, and that decision has to be made by a support manager rather than a first-line agent.

Since your charge was 40 days ago, it falls outside the standard refund window. However, because you've also raised the possibility of a chargeback, I'm escalating this ticket directly to a manager for review right away — this is handled as a priority regardless of the 14-day window. I'm not able to approve or process a refund myself, but a manager will follow up with you directly on next steps.

Thanks for your patience while this gets reviewed.

Best,
Loopwise Support
